allEvidence.quote: 1.非中国籍公民，身心健康；
2.年龄17周岁以上，30周岁以下（以入学年份9月1日为准）；
Aged 17 years or above and under 30 years of age (Based on the year of September 1st).
3.拥有高中及以上毕业证书；
4.HSK 4级200以上（在有效期内）或托福80，单科不得低于20/ 雅思6.0，单科不得低于5.5/多邻国115，单科不低于115；
5.需提供“来华留学本科入学学业水平测试”（China Scholastic Competency Assessment, 简称“CSCA测试”）成绩单。CSCA具体介绍及报名方式请登录官方网站（https://csca.cn/home）查看。
1.申请人如能提供有效期内HSK四级180分以上成绩报告，可免考专业中文。

2.数学、物理、化学均提供中英文试卷，申请人可根据授课语言要求选择试卷语种。Examinations for Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry are offered in Chinese and English. Applicants can select the paper language as required by the medium of instruction.
二、标准学习期限：4年
申请开始时间：每年1月1日
申请截止时间：每年6月15日
入学时间：每年9月初

8.有效期1年以上的普通护照（以入学年份9月1日为准）。注：（1）如你计划更换护照，请在申请前完成，并取得新护照。（2）除此之外，请勿更换护照。否则影响办理签证及后续入校报道。
9.18岁以下请提供《未成年留学生监护人保证书》（以入学年份9月1日为准）。
（1）登陆在线申请网站https://swu.17gz.org完成注册；
1.申请费:500元/人（该费用不予退还）

scopeWarnings: The official workbook publishes 2027-2028: preserve this range, unlike XMU/NWAFU literal-year cases.
Self-funded deadline is June 15; New Silk Road scholarship May 15 and CSC-B February 15 must not be borrowed.
The programme list contains multiple HSK scores and duplicate names across schools. This batch intentionally binds five unique exact Chinese names to their own school/row and HSK200 cells.
No English names are printed for these rows; verifiedName remains zh only.
Row sequence numbers are not published major codes.
The quoted CSCA STEM table lists Chinese, Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry together; do not change it to an either/or rule.
The shared CSCA note spans four language/category rows. Its HSK180 professional-Chinese exemption is separate from the selected majors HSK200 admission requirement.
The source labels the CSCA subject 中文 without specifying 理科中文; do not invent a more detailed paper direction.
No application time zone is explicitly printed.

The general guide has an OR-list of language tests; the selected Chinese-programme-specific XLSX rows explicitly require HSK4 score200. Do not infer English-test substitution for these Chinese tracks.
Prior-degree medium-of-instruction evidence is an alternative document in the guide; do not promise automatic waiver without school review.
